render.prompt: Use the attached photo as the identity reference. Keep the exact same face shape, eye spacing, nose shape, lip shape, skin tone, hairline, hairstyle and expression; the person must remain clearly recognizable. Apply makeup only, do not reshape the face, do not enlarge the eyes, do not change skin depth. Base: soft-focus cloud-skin finish, light coverage, even tone, natural skin texture with visible pores, no plastic sheen. Brows: wild soft-arched gray-brown, soft feathered edges, lighter at the inner head. Eyes: pink-brown matte eyeshadow within the crease and deepened at the outer corner and outer lower lash line, brown eyeliner on the outer half with a very slight wing, thin natural mascara, subtle aegyo-sal. Contour: light cool gray-brown along the nose sides and an arc under the jaw angle, fully blended. Highlight: matte highlight under the eyes, on the nasolabial folds and nasal base; a tiny shimmer at the nose tip and inner corners only. Blush: sheer warm peach cream blush swept diagonally up across the cheek and lightly over the nose bridge, blurred edges. Lips: soft-matte nude milk-tea lip, blurred edge, no harsh lip line. Keep the same framing, lighting direction, background, hair and clothing. Photorealistic portrait, 85mm lens, soft directional window light, neutral background, natural color grading, sharp focus on the face, no beauty filter.
render.negative: different person, changed face shape, slimmed jaw, enlarged eyes, reshaped nose, different skin tone, over-smoothed skin, plastic skin, heavy filter, glossy grease, harsh lines, smudged makeup, extra jewelry, different hairstyle, different background, heavy false lashes, thick black eyeliner

qa.fallback: identity_sim < 0.6 -> 强度 x0.7 并从原图重跑；仍失败 -> face swap 回贴原脸
